tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor la brten nas rnal 'byor pa rnams zab lam byang chub sgrub pa'i rim pa bklags chog ma bzhugs lags// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza shrī he badz+ra yā/ 'phags yul grub mchog dpal ldan chos skyong zhabs/ /gang de'i zab don snyan brgyud du ma'i mdzod/ /sa skya'i bla chen brgyud par bcas rnams la/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag btsal nas/ /gsung ngag rin chen zab mo'i gnad kyi don/ /rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor lam mchog la brten nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang bgrod pa'i thabs/ /bla ma'i phyag len gsung rgyun 'dir bri'o/ /de la yang 'dir/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa rdzogs par thob pa'i gang zag gis/ rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor gyi zab mo'i lam 'di la brten cing / lus kyi rtsa mdud rnams grol bar byas nas/ thun mong du nad gdon gyi bar chad zhi ba dang / mthar thug sa lam rnams rim kyis bgrod nas/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ lam 'di nyid nyams su blang bar byed pa la/ lus sbyong dang 'khrul 'khor gyi rim pa gnyis gsungs shing / dang po lus sbyong ba la yang bsdus pa dang rgyas pa gnyis las/ de'i dang po bsdus pa yan lag lnga'i sbyang ba dang / gnyis pa lus sbyong rgyas pa nyi shu pa bya ba'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mgo bo mjing pa bsgyur bya zhing / /lag pa gnyis ni so sor g.yab/ /rkang pa gnyis kyang drag tu dkrug /yan lag lnga ni sbyang ba 'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ de yang mgo bo la bzhi lag pa la bzhi/ rkang pa la bzhi ste de rnams bya ba'i tshul la thog mar sngon 'gro ma da na'i sbyor ba bya ste/ de la rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung byas la/ lag pa gnyis mdun du shad de brkyangs pa'i lag mthil gnyis mnyes nas thog mar mig la lan gsum byug de nas mgo bo nas brtsams te lus thams cad khyab par byug par bya'o/ /de nas mgo bo'i bzhi ni/

rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung / lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur nang bsdams pa bsnol bar snying khar gcer/ de nas rlung sna g.yon dang g.yas dang gnyis ka nas lan re re phyir bus rjes rlung nang du dal bus brngubs nas bzung la de nas rna ba dpung mgo la reg par g.yas su bskor ba gsum/ de bzhin g.yon du bskor ba gsum/ yang mdun rgyab tu kos ko brang la thug par sdeb pa gsum/ yang g.yas g.yon du sdeb pa gsum/ yang g.yas dang g.yon dang / g.yon nas g.yas su drang por lta ba gsum ste mgo bo'i bzhi'o/ /rlung mi thub na dal bus btang la/ lag pa'i bzhi ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung lag pa rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bsnol la/ rlung ro lan gcig bus nas rlung bzung / lag pa g.yas kyi mgo bo la g.yas su bskor nas g.yas su dkrugs te de lta bu gsum/ yang lag pa g.yon pas mgo bo la g.yon du bskor nas g.yon du dkrugs pa ste lan gsum/ yang lag pa gnyis kas mgo bo la g.yas g.yon du so sor bskor la g.yas g.yon du dkrugs pa gsum/ yang lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings pa dpung mgo'i 'og tu dus gcig tu bsnun zhing dus gcig tu mdun du brkyang ba gsum yang khu tshur bsnol ma snying kar bcas la phyir bskyed nas sgrog rus pa'i 'og tsam du tshur bsnun pa gsum ste lag pa'i bzhi'o/ /yang rlung mi thub na dal bus btang la/ rkang pa'i bzhi ni/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung lag pa khu tshur snying khar bcang ba/ rlung ro 'bud pa/ rlung bzung ba rnams gong bzhin las/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung bshig cing gdan la brdab cing langs la/ rkang pa g.yas pa'i rting pa 'phongs la brdeg cing mdun du dkrug pa gsum/ g.yon rgyab tu dkrug pa gsum/ yang g.yon gyi rting pa 'phongs la brdeg cing mdun du dkrug pa gsum/ g.yas rgyab tu dkrug pa gsum/ de nas g.yas pas g.yon pa'i long bu nas brla khugs kyi bar du gyen la shud de g.yas su dkrug pa gsum/

yang g.yon pas g.yas pa'i long bu nas brla khugs pa'i bar du gyen la shud de g.yon du dkrug pa gsum/ yang g.yas pas g.yon pa'i bol gong la bskor la dpus mo'i ltag nas g.yon du dkrug pa gsum mo/ /de nas rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krungs/ khu tshur snying khar bsnol la rlung phyir drag tu 'bud/ de thams cad la steng rlung bsdams nas bya yi bum pa can 'dzin mi dgos so/ /'di ni lus sbyongs bsdus pa yin lags/ gnyis pa lus sbyong rgyas pa nyi shu bya ba'i tshul ni/ dang po lag bkru lta bu ste/ zhes pa ni/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung / khu tshur snying gar bsnol la rlung phyir drag tu 'bud/ de thams cad la steng rlung bsdams nas bya yi bum pa can 'dzin mi dgos so/ /'di ni lus sbyong bsdus pa yin lags/ gnyis pa lus sbyong rgyas pa nyi shu pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ dang po lag bkru lta bu ste/ /zhes pa ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung / khu tshur snying khar bsnol bas rlung ro 'bud cing rlung bzung ba sogs gong bzhin/ de nas lag pa gnyis mdun du sangs brkyangs la/ lag mthil gnyis sprad la drag tu shud/ mgo bo/ mjing pa/ gdong / pus mo/ rkang ngar gnyis/ rkang mthil rnams shud pa'o/ /de nas rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying khar bsnol la rlung drag tu phyir 'bud/ gnyis pa lag bzlog brang la gcer/ /zhes pa ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung nas rlung bzung ba'i bar gong bzhin/ lag gnyis rdo rje bsdams pasnying gar gcer/ gru mo gnyis rgyab tu dgyed byas la/ de nas lag mthil gnyis phyir la bstan te mdun du drang por brkyang / yang nang du bstan te brang la gcer/ yang mthe bong gnyis phyir bstan te steng du drang por brkyang ba'o/ /rjes gong bzhin/ 'og ma bcu pa yan la 'gre'o/ /gsum pa lag bzung brla snying gnon/ zhes pa ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung nas rlung bzung ba'i bar gong bzhin lag pa g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur drang por/

rkang pa g.yas pa'i brla'i dkyil phyi zur la cung nye bar bzhag pa'i steng du g.yas pa'i lag mthil bkag la mnye ba'o/ /de bzhin g.yon pa la'ang go bzlog pa'o/ /bzhi pa bsnol nas lus bag gcu/ /zhes pa ni/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying khar bsnol zhing rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas rdo rje skyil krung bshig cing gdan la gdab nas/ rkang pa g.yon pa'i sgyid khung du g.yas pa'i pus mo bcug lag pa g.yas g.yon pas bzung ste/ gru mo g.yas g.yon gyi gru mo'i nang ngos nas btang ba'i pus mo g.yas ngos cung zad bsnol zhing / lag mgo'i 'gram pa g.yon nas g.yas su phul ba'o/ /g.yon pa'ang de bzhin go bzlog ste shes par bya ste lus tsog pu bya'o/ /lnga pa gzhu sran 'gengs pa 'dra/ /zhes pa ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung nas rlung bzung ba'i bar gong bzhin/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur rgyab sprad pa mdun du brkyangs te/ gzhu 'gengs pa bzhin g.yas dang g.yon du re mos kyis lan gsum bya'o/ /drug pa khu tshur bcang brang brdung / /zhes pa ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung nas rlung bzung ba'i bar gong bzhin/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur g.ya' khung ba'i ltag tu so sor kha phyir bstan te/ mdun du drang por brkyang ba dang khu tshur sngar bzhin bzlogs te brang la bsnun pa gsum bya'o/ /bdun pa lag gnyis rdo gcog 'dra/ /zhes pa ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung nas rlung bzung ba'i bar gong bzhin de nas khu tshur snying khar bsnol zhing rdo rje skyil krung bshigs nas gdan la gdab/ pus mo gnyis gdan la btsugs la/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur g.yas dang / g.yon gyi phrag par khyer la g.yas g.yon gyi 'og phyogs su dkrug pa lan gsum gsum bya'o/ /brgyad pa gru mo gnyis ka dgyed/ /ces pa ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung nas rlung bzung ba'i bar gong bzhin/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur bsnol ba phrag par sleb la khad pa sor mo kha nang du lta/

dgyed pa'i dus su khu tshur so sor 'phral la nu ma'i rtsar lag mgo sleb pa dang / sor mo kha phyir blta bar bya ste gru mo gnyis rgyab la dgyed pa lan gsum bya'o/ /dgu pa skyil krung ri 'phul 'dra/ /zhes pa ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung nas rlung bzung ba'i bar gong bzhin/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi mthe bong bsnol mar 'chang bar dam du bsdams/ snying ga nas lto ba'i bar mar bzhar te mdun na phar 'gro tshur phul/ dpral ba sa la reg par bya/ yang khu tshur rim gyis log ste snying khar sleb pa dang / steng phyogs su sangs te brkyangs la phyir ltag pa sa la reg ste lag pa'ang 'gro tshad skyong ba ste de 'dra ba lan gsum bya'o/ /bcu pa lag gnyis brten lus bskum/ /zhes pa ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung nas rlung bzung ba'i bar gong bzhin/ lag pa gnyis g.yas g.yon du sa la btsugs te tshang ra bar snang la btegs te ci nus bsdod pa'o/ /'di yan chad la/ bzhi pa dang / bdun pa gnyis ma gtogs rdo rje skyil krung kho na yin/ man chad langs la bya'o/ /bcu gcig lag 'khyud brla steng dgug /ces pa ni/ langs te khu tshur snying khar bsnol bas rlung ro lan gcig bus la rlung bzung / lag pa g.yas rgyab phyogs nas btang / g.yon pa rkang pa g.yon pa'i sgyid khung nas btang ste/ rdo rje bsdams pa byas la lungs drang por bsrang la/ g.yon pa'ang de bzhin go bzlog la bya'o/ /de nas khu tshur snying khar bsnol la rlung drag tu 'bud/ bcu gnyis bgrangs nas lan gsum snyeng / /zhes pa ni/ langs nas rlung bzung ba'i bar 'dra ba las/ rkang pa gnyis gshibs te rting pa bteg la/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur thur la bcangs pa grim pa dal bus gyen la 'gro tshad brkyangs te lan gsum snyengs pa'o/ /rjes gong bzhin bcu gsum khu tshur rgyab brdungs pa/ /zhes pa ni/ langs nas rlung bzung ba'i bar 'dra/ de nas rkang pa gnyis cung zhig bgrad de rting pa bteg

ltag pa 'gyed byas la khu tshur gnyis kyis re mos kyis tshigs pa bdun pa lan gsum gsum brdung ba'o/ /rjes gong bzhin/ bcu bzhi lag stong stag ltar ston/ /zhes pa ni/ langs nas rlung bzung ba'i bar 'dra ba las/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje khu tshur gyis so sor kha phyir bstan te 'chang ba'i gong nu ma g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag g.yon rdo rje khu tshur nu ma'i thad nas gcer la gre mo g.yas pa g.yon dang g.yas su bskor ba gsum gsum bya/ lag pa g.yon pa'ang de bzhin go bzlogs te shes par bya'o/ /rjes gong bzhin/ bco lnga bgreng la lan gsum dgye/ /zhes pa ni/ langs nas rlung bzung ba'i bar 'dra/ rkang pa'i rting pa bteg la cung zad bgrad de/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur thur la brkyang ba grim cha dang bcas pa snying kha thub dal bus gyen la bzlog snying khar slebs pa dang lag gnyis dus gcig la steng du brkyangs la ltag pa dgyed par byed pa lan gsum bya'o/ /rjes gong bzhin/ bcu drug lag gnyis bsnol nang du/ /rkang bcug g.yas pa'i phyogs su drangs/ /zhes pa ni/ langs nas rlung bzung ba'i bar 'dra/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa'i mthil du rkang pa g.yas pa'i sgyu ma khug bzhag la/ rkang pa drang por brkyangs te/ lag pas rting pa yar bzhar te sna rtse thug par lan gsum bzhar ro/ /de bzhin g.yon pa la'ang shes par bya'o/ /rjes gong bzhin/ bcu bdun mdun rgyab 'khrab par bya/ /zhes pa ni/ langs nas rlung bzung ba'i bar 'dra/ rkang pa g.yas pa'i rting pa 'phongs la brdeg cing mdun du dkrug pa gsum/ /g.yon rgyab tu dkrug pa gsum/ de bzhin du g.yas g.yon go bzlogs te bya'o/ /rjes gong bzhin/ bco brgyad rkang g.yas pus mo ni/ /g.yon pa'i rkang pas mnan par bya/ /g.yon pa'ang de bzhin shes pa bya/ /zhes pa ni/ langs nas rlung bzung ba'i bar 'dra/ rkang pa g.yas drang por brkyangs pa'i pus mo'i ltag tu g.yon pa'i sgyu ma khung bzhag ste rkang mgo thur bzhar/

rtser btang zhing g.yon pa'ang de bzhin bzlog pa'o/ /rjes gong bzhin/ bcu dgu gsang ba'i rtse nas drangs/ /zhes pa ni/ langs nas rlung bzung ba'i bar 'dra/ lag gnyis gsang gnas su sor mo dang bcas drang por brkyang ba'i bar che chung ling ga'i tshad tsam gyi rtsar bzhag ste/ gru mo drang por bar la che chung ma shor bar steng du bgrod tshad drangs te lag pa'i bar nas mgo bo 'don cing / de 'dra ba lan gsum bya'o/ /rjes gong bzhin/ nyi shu sngar bzhin 'khrab par bya/ /zhes pa ni/ dang po lugs 'byung / de nas lugs bzlog 'chol par yang bya'o/ de dag gis ni lus sbyong rgyas bsdus gnyis bya tshul bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa 'khrul 'khor bya tshul la/ 'phrin las so gnyis sdom dang bcas bshad par bya ba la thog mar sdom tshig ni/ dzā lan dha ra ham̐ pa pa ru ka /o ḍī ya na pad+ma rdo rje dang / /tso rang gi dang a pa ra pa ta/ /gau ta karma dang ni dzam trag go /u pa ku ra pa dang tsa la na/ /na ba li gnyis sing ga li dang gsum/ /mnyam gzhag bha la tsakra a ma ra/ /a par pa ra arta bha we ta/ /ghu ma na'u ga na tso ri gi /rkang mthil bskyod dang yan lag lnga sbyong dang / /ham̐ sa pak+ṣi hi sa ḍeṃ ki pa/ kum pa kurma seng ge rnam rol gsum/ /yang na na ba mi gnyis gcig tu byas/ rlung sbyor bdun po bsnan pas sum cu gnyis/ zhes gsungs pa'i/ de thams cad kyi thun mong gi sngon 'gro ma da na'i sbyor ba ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung byas te/ lag pa gnyis mdun du shad de brkyangs la lag mthil gnyis drod skyes skyes kyi bar du bshud la/ de nas lag mthil gnyis kyis mig gnyis dang gdong pa lag ngar rkang mthil byin pa sogs lus kyi cha thams cad drod skyes skyes shud do/ /de nas 'phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis dngos la/ dang po ni/ dzā lan dha ra spyi gtsug dgug par bya/ /'og sgo stan la ma reg rkang gnyis bgrad/ /tsog bu lag gnyis bsgom thag tshul du 'khril/

/khrag dang ma zhu bad kan nad rnams sel/ /zhes pa ltar/ rkang pa'i rting pa gnyis kyi bar du sor drug tsam bzhag nas rkang mgo phyir bskyed/ lus drang por langs la khu tshur gnyis snying gar bsnol nas rlung ro 'bud cing rlung kha sbyar bzung / de'i ngang nas lag pa gnyis rna ba'i thad kyi bar snang la bya'i gshog pa ltar shad kyis brkyangs/ de nas lag pa gnyis dal bus mgo bo'i thad du bskums nas/ g.yon pa'i lag mthil gyis g.yas pa'i gru mo'i rgyab nas bzung / de gnyis dal bu'i mar phab nas pus mo gnyis la bskon/ mgo bo thur du bkug pa pus mo gnyis kyi bar du bcug 'phongs sa la ma reg tsam gyi ngang la bsdod/ de nas bshig ste rdo rje skyil krung bcas/ khu tshur snying gar bsnol te rlung sna g.yon nas dal bus 'bud do/ /gnyis pa ni/ ham̐ sa pa ru ka ni tsog pu ste/ /'di yang 'og sgo stan la ma reg pa/ /rting pa cung bsnol rdo rje bsdams pas 'khyud/ /yan lag nad sel mig la phan pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ rkang mgo gnyis phyir bkyed/ rting pa gnyis cung zad bsnol/ lus drang por bsrangs/ khu tshur snying gar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas lag gnyis rna ba'i thad kyi bar snang la bya gshog ltar shad kyis brkyangs/ de nas lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa spyi bo'i thad kyi bar snang la yar 'then 'then pa gsum byas/ de nas dal bus mar phabs nas rdo rje bsdams pa pus mo gnyis la bskon nas lag mgo gyen la bslangs/ ltag pa phyir bkyed/ 'phongs sa la ma reg pa'i ngang la lus grim sha bskyed de ci thub thub sdod/ de nas bshig ste rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying khar bsnol ba rlung 'bud pa sogs gong bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ o ḍi ya na rna ba g.yas pa'i phyogs/ /lag pa gtod de g.yon pas rim gyis ded/ /g.yon pa'ang de bzhin mgo dkrug skyil krung yin/ /bad kan nad sel lag pa'i nad la phan/

/zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung bcas/ khu tshur snying khar bsnol ba'i ngang la rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas g.yas pa'i khu tshur g.yon pa'i gru mo'i thad nas phar brkyangs pa de rkyong bzhin pa'i ngang nas mdun phyogs nas bskor ba g.yas kyi dpung pa'i thad la bar snang nas thal gyis brkyangs/ de nas gru mo bkug nas khu tshur rtsib logs la thug ste rgyab nas yar rna ba'i thad kyi bar snang la shad kyis brkyangs pa de la/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur kha phye nas mar byil por shud pa dang dus mnyam du mgo dkrug de bzhin g.yon pa'i khu tshur g.yas pa'i gru mo'i thad nas phar brkyangs pa nas mgo dkrugs pa'i bar gong bzhin/ de nas khu tshur snying gar bsnol nas rlung dal bus 'bud do/ /bzhi pa ni/ pad+ma rdo rje skyil krung bol gong sprad/ /rdo rje bsdams pa lte ba'i thad kar gcer/ /pad+ma rdo rje 'dra ste lte bar gcer/ /tshe ring ba dang ban kan nad la phan/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying khar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas rkang pa gnyis mdun du brkyang / g.yon pa'i bol gong gi steng na phar g.yas pa btang ste bol gong gnyis sbyar/ lag gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa lte bar gyen du bslangs te bzhag lto ba rgal tshigs la gcer/ ro stod phyi la bkyed nas rkang pa gnyis cung zad bteg cing pus mo gnyis sbug mor brkyangs nas/ rting pa gnyis gsus pa la lan gsum rgyag pa dang / lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa lta bar gcer ba lan gsum bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying khar bsnol nas rlung 'bud pa sogs gong bzhin/ lnga pa ni/ co rang gi ni skyil krung lus po srong / /mjing pa yang gcu rdo rje bsdams pa ni/ /snying khar drag tu gcer na ma zhu dang / /be snabs 'khru dang lus po thang chad sel/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying khar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung /

de nas rdo rje bsnams pa snying khar gyen du bslangs nas dam du gcer/ lus drang por bsring / mig mi mgul bar/ ol gong dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi steng du bskyel ba lan gsum bya'o/ /de nas khu tshur snying khar bsnol bas rlung 'bud do/ /drug pa ni/ a par sa ra lus srong skyil krung ste/ /lag mthil bsnol bas ltag pa'i phyogs nas bkug /ma khugs lus mdar mgo bo yang yang bsgyur/ /stobs chen mgo bo'i nad ni sel ba'i mchog /ces pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying khar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas lag pa gnyis shad de brkyang nas g.yon par ltag par bkab pa'i steng du g.yas bkab/ gru mo gnyis mdun du gshibs te/ de nyid dbus dang g.yas dang g.yon rnams su lan gsum gsum dgug pas brang dang rtsibs logs gnyis la brdeg go /de nas khu tshur snying khar bsnol bas rlung 'bud pa'o/ /bdun pa ni/ gau ra karmā lus bsrang skyil krung ste/ /rdo rje bsdams pa snying ka'i steng du gtsir/ /rta yi mgo bzhin mgo bo dgug par bya/ /lus 'tshe nad rnams thams cad sel ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying khar bsnol bas rlung bcing bzung / de nas lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa snying kha'i stod tsam du gyen la bstan nas dam du gcer/ mgo bo rta'i mgo phyogs ltar mdun dang g.yas g.yon rnams su lan gsum gsum dgug de nas khu tshur snying khar bsnol nas rlung 'bud do/ /brgyad pa ni/ dzam tra skyil krung lus po drang bar bya/ /lag pa bsnol bas dpung pa dam du bsdams/ /lto gcer mgo bgrad mig dkrug dge dgu bya/ /pho ba sbos dang skran dang ma zhu sel/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying khar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis bsnol bas dpung pa phan tshun dam du bsdams/ lto ba rgal tshigs la sbyar zhing mig bgrad pa'i ngang nas mgo dkrug

de nas rdo rje skyil krung dang dpung pa ma bshig pa'i ngang nas/ mdun du gru mo gnyis phar brkyang zhing 'gro tshad phul/ skyil krung rgyab tu brkyangs nas brang sa la sbyar/ de nas langs nas rgyab tu 'gyel nas rgal tshigs dang mgo bo'i ltag pa sa la sbyar/ gru mo yang rgyab la 'gro tshad phul/ de 'dra ba lan gsum bya'o/ /de nas langs nas khu tshur snying khar bsnol nas rlung 'bud do/ /dgu pa ni/ u pa ku ra pa ni tsog pu ste/ /pus mo gang rung steng du sgyid khung bzhag /de steng lag gnyis bsnol ba kong kos gnon/ /drod chen rlung med dang po'i gzugs rgu yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ langs te lus drang por bsrang / rkang pa g.yon pa'i pus mo'i steng du g.yas pa'i sgyid khung bkag nas rkang mthil g.yon pa'i g.yon du sa la bzhag khu tshur snying khar bsnol nas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas lag pa gnyis bya'i gshog pa ltar shad kyis brkyangs la dal bus mar phab dpral ba'i thad du bkug nas lag pa g.yon pa'i rgyab la g.yas pa'i lag mthil bkab pa la mgo dang mnyam du mar phab nas pus mo'i steng du ma bral ba bkab/ de'i steng du lkog ma bzhag 'phongs mar phab nas sa la ma reg pa'i ngang bsdod/ de nas khu tshur snying khar bsnol te rlung 'bud do/ /de bzhin du g.yas pa'i pus mo'i steng du g.yon gyi sgyud khung bkab nas g.yas pa'i g.yas su g.yon pa bzhag nas sngar bzhin byed pa sogs 'dra'o/ /bcu pa ni/ skyil krung pus mo'i steng nas lag pas mnan/ /dgye tshe lto ba mdun du 'bur ba yin/ /kha sbyor re la g.yas su bskor ba dang / /g.yon gcu lto ba'i nad sel rtsa la na/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying khar bsnol te rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas lag pa gnyis pus mo la bkab ste/ cung zad dgug pa'i ngang nas lto ba mdun la 'bur byas/ rgal tshigs dang lag pa la sogs pa ma gug par lto ba g.yas g.yon du bskor ba lan gsum gsum bya'o/

/de nas khu tshur snying khar bsnol te rlung 'bud do/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ pus mo'i steng du gcig gi sgyid khung bzhag /de steng sor mo nang bstan lag mthil bzhag /de steng dpral bas mnan la kha sbyar bya/ /drod chen na ba li ste gong ma yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ gzhan rnams u pa ku ra pa ji lta ba bzhin la/ lag pa brkyangs nas bskum pa'i skabs su dpral ba'i thad du lag pa g.yas pa'i rgyab tu g.yon pa'i nang sbyar nas mar dal bus phab ste/ pus mo'i steng du lag pa gnyis ma bral bar kha gyen du bstan nas bzhag pa'i steng du dpral ba bzhag sdod pa'o/ /g.yon pa'ang de las go bzlog ste shes par bya'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ skyil krung g.yas pa'i lag pa g.yon du gcu/ /dpung pa dag nas g.yon par thur la ded/ /g.yon pa'ang de bzhin na ba li gnyis pa/ /drod che 'dus dang ma zhu'i nad kun sel/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying gar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas lag pa g.yas su shad kyis brkyangs/ de nas gru mo gug byas te khu tshur rtsibs logs la thag rgyab nas khu tshur g.yon pa'i pus mo'i steng ya tshad du brkyangs pa de la lag pa g.yon pas g.yas pa'i dpung pa nas mar shud/ de bzhin du g.yon pa'i khu tshur g.yon la shad de brkyangs/ de nas gru mo gug byas te khu tshur rtsibs logs la thag rgyab nas/ khu tshur g.yas pa'i pus mo'i steng ya tshad du brkyangs pa de la/ lag pa g.yas pas g.yon pa'i dpung pa na mar shud pa'o/ /rjes gong bzhin/ bcu gsum pa ni/ sing ga li ste tsog pu pus mo bsnol/ /pus mkhyud bcug la rdo rje bsdams pa ni/ /snying khar bzhag cing lag gnyis bar du bcang / /mgo nad mig nad dbugs ma bde ba sel/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying gar bsnol la rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas pus po gnyis steng rong byas la rkang mgo gnyis phan tshun bsnol/ pus po gnyis dang sked pa lhan cig tu pus mkhyud kyis bcings/

de nas lag pa rdo rje bsdams pa gyen du bslangs la brang la yar shud mar shud byed pa dang gru mo gnyis kyi pus mo gnyis phyir phul/ pus mos gru mo nang la phul la ngo bo rtsal 'gran yin/ rjes rnams gong bzhin/ bcu bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje skyil krung mnyam bzhag phyag rgya yis/ /lto ba gcer zhing rlung ni rang so bzung / /thang chad pa dang 'du ba 'khrugs pa dang / /bad kan be snabs nad las grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung byas nas rting pa'i steng du lag pa gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya bzhag ste gru mo gnyis drang por bsrang / lto ba rgal tshigs la gcer/ rlung drang por bzhag nas sdod pa'o/ /bco lnga pa ni/ bha la tsakra skyil krung lag gnyis kyis/ /brla yi steng mnan mgo bo dal gyis skyor/ /g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba gnyis ka bya/ /kha tshul mchu dang mgo nad ma lus sel/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying gar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong brla g.yas pa'i nang du bzhag cing sor mo rnams brla'i phyi la btang nas drang por btsugs/ lag pa g.yon pa brla g.yon pa'i steng du gong bzhin byas la/ de'i ngang nas mgo dal bus g.yas su bskor zhing bskyod pa gsum dang / g.yon du bskor nas bskyod pa gsum bya/ rjes gong bzhin/ bcu drug pa ni/ a ma ra ni skyil krung bde bar bsdad/ /lag pa gnyis kyi longs spyod rlabs gnyis btsir/ /rlung ni kha sbyor bzhin ni spungs pa ste/ /'chi ba bslu zhing ting 'dzin myur du skye/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying gar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong mgrin pa'i bar bzhag cing / sor mo rnams ltag par bskyal/ g.yon pa'ang de bzhin du byas nas mgrin pa'i longs spyod kyi rtsa btsal rnyed byung ba dang mthe bong gnyis kyis mnan pas rtsa 'dabs thebs pa'o/

/rjes gong bzhin no/ /bcu bdun pa ni/ a par pa ra skyil krung bde bar bca'/ /lag gnyis brtsegs pas ltag pa'i phyogs su dgab/ /gru mo mdun du ma rgu lus brjid bskur/ /mgo nad 'dus dang ma zhu skyug pa sel/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying gar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas lag pa g.yon pa kha phub ste ltag par sbyar/ de'i steng du lag pa g.yas pa'ang de bzhin du bzhag de ltag pa la dam du sbyar te phar shud tshur shud bya/ de'i tshe gru mo thad kar brkyangs mdun du ma gug pa bya'o/ /rjes gong bzhin no/ /bco brgyad pa ni/ ar ta bha we ta ka pus mo bskum/ /lag pa gnyis kyis sgom thag tshul du 'khyud/ /gang na 'og tu bcug ste nyal bar bya/ /gang na ba dang 'dus dang ma zhu sel/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying gar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas rkang pa gnyis gshibs te pus mo gnyis rong byas pa la/ lag pa gnyis kyis bsgom thag tshul du bcings/ de ma zhig pa'i ngang la g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab rnams su 'gyel thengs re bya'o/ /rjes gong bzhin/ bcu dgu pa ni/ ghu ma na 'u bho la rdo rje yi/ /skyil krung mthe bong rgyab nas lag pa gnyis/ /bsnol bas bzung bas nad rnams kun sel cing / /khyad par rkang nad sel ba'i mchog yin no/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying gar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas lag pa g.yas pa rgyab nas btang ste rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong bzung / lag pa g.yon pas rgyab nas btang ste rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong bzung / sgal tshigs drang por bsrang ba kho na'o/ /rjes gong bzhin/ nyi shu pa ni/ ga na tsau ram̐ gi ni skyil krung ste/ /rdo rje bsdams pa'i gung mo brkyang la sbyar/ /zlog la spyi bo'i steng gtsug kha mig bgrad/ /lto gcer kha sbyar rlung skyon thams cad sel/ /zhes pa ltar/

rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying gar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa'i gung mo gnyis rtse sprad pa spyi bo'i steng du bzlog ste btsugs/ kha mig bgrad/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer/ rjes gong bzhin/ nyer gcig pa ni/ rkang mthil bskyod pa'i 'khrul 'khor rkang pa brkyang / /lag pa stan la bzhag la rkang pa ni/ /ya gcig bkug ste ya gcig drag tu dkrug /de bzhin ya gcig bya ste rkang nad sel/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil mo krung khu tshur snying khar bsnol bas rlung 'bad cing bzung nas skyil krung bshig la gdan la gdab/ de nas lag pa gnyis rgyab tu lag mthil sa la sbyar nas btsugs/ rkang pa gnyis mdun du rkang mthil sa la sbyar te btsugs 'phongs nam mkha' la bteg de'i ngang nas rkang pa g.yas phar shad de brkyang / tshur bskums pa dang rting pa 'phongs la brdeg pa lan gsum/ de bzhin g.yas pa sa la btsugs/ g.yon pa'i rting pa 'phongs la brdeg pa sogs lan gsum bya'o/ /rjes gong bzhin no/ /nyer gnyis pa/ nyer gsum pa/ nyer bzhi pa/ nyer lnga pa/ nyer drug pa rnams ni/ de nas yan lag lnga yi sbyor ba ni/ /lag mjang pa sgyur ma lag gnyis g.yab/ /skyil krung lag pas mnan la lus po cu/ /rkang pa gnyis kyang mdun rgyab rab tu dkrug /ces pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying gar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas mgo bo g.yas su bskor ba lan gsum dang / g.yon du bskor ba lan gsum bya'o/ /de nas mgo bo mdun du dgug pa gsum dang / rgyab tu dgyed pa gsum spel ma bya/ g.yas su 'jog pa gsum dang / g.yon du 'jog pa gsum spel ma bya'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yas mgo la g.yon bskor byas nas g.yas su shad de brkyang ba gsum/ g.yon pa mgo la g.yas su bskor ba byas nas g.yon du shad de brkyang ba gsum bya'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yon pa khu tshur snying khar bcangs nas g.yas pa mdun du shad de brkyangs/

tshur bskums pa dang khu tshur dpung pa la brdeg de 'dra ba lan gsum bya'o/ /g.yon pa'ang de bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas lag pa gnyis ka mnyam du pus mo'i steng du shad de brkyangs/ tshur bskum pa dang khu tshur nu steng du brdeg de 'dra ba lan gsum bya'o/ /de nas lag pa gnyis kas mgo bo la bskor nas g.yas g.yon thad kar shad shad brkyang ba gsum bya'o/ /de rnams la phar skyong tsa na sor mo rnams kyang brkyang bar bya'o/ /de nas lag pa gnyis kyi mthil pus mo la bkab nas/ 'phongs sa dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ dpung pa g.yas pa pus mo g.yon pa la reg dpung pa g.yon pa pus mo g.yas pa la reg pa de 'dra ba lan gsum bya'o/ /de rlung mi thub na dal bus btang / yang rlung bzung nas langs te khu tshur snying gar bsnol/ rkang pa g.yas pa mdun du lan gsum dkrug g.yon pa rgyab tu lan gsum dkrug de nas g.yas pa rgyab tu lan gsum dkrug de nas g.yon pa mdun du lan gsum dkrug de nas rkang pa g.yas pas/ g.yon pa'i byin pa yar shud de pus mo'i thad sleb pa dang / mdun na phar bskor te g.yas su bskum byas nas/ g.yon pa'i pus mo'i thad na phar shan shad dkrugs pa lan gsum bya'o/ /g.yon pa'ang g.yas pa'i byin pa nas yar shud de pus mo'i thad du sleb pa dang mdun nas phar bskor te g.yon du bskum byas te g.yas pa'i pus mo'i thad na phar shad shad dkrug pa lan gsum bya'o/ /de nas stan la 'dug nas rdo rje skyil krung bcas te khu tshur snying gar bsnol nas rlung dal bus btang ngo / /nyer bdun pa ni/ ham̐ pa pak+ṣi lag gnyis rkang pa yin/ /nang du bcug la rkang pa bskums nas ni/ /lag pa gnyis la lus kyi lcid bskur ba/ /ngang pa'i gshog pa lta bu'i 'khrul 'khor yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying khar bsnol nas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas khu tshur gnyis brla'i nang du gshibs te sa la btsugs nas gru mo gnyis bsrang la sbyar/

de nas lus kyi lcid bskur te rkang pa gnyis bskums pa gru mo'i thad tsam du bteg la skum me 'dug pa'o/ /rjes 'dra/ nyer brgyad pa ni/ rdo rje skyil krung sgyid khung bar na mar/ /lag gnyis btsangs te ma shong phyi nas kyang / /lag pa gnyis la lus kyi lcid bkal ba/ /ham̐ pa zhes pa dang po'i 'khrul 'khor yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying khar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas rdo rje skyil krung bcas pa'i sgyid khung bar na mar lag pa gnyis bcug ste lus kyi lcid bskur la rkang pa gnyis bskum/ ro stod drang por bsrang ste sdod pa'o/ /de rjes 'dra/ nyer gsum ni/ kha phub lus po brkyangs pa'i dpung pa dang / /gru mo brang dang lto sbyar lag gnyis la/ /lus kyi lcid bskur mgo dang rkang pa gnyis/ /re mos sa la thug pa ṭam̐ gi yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung snying gar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas rdo rje skyil krung bshig cing stan la gdab nas langs te/ khu tshur gnyis sa la gshibs te btsugs/ gru mo gnyis brang la sbyar ba la lus kyi lcid bkal/ rkang pa gnyis rgyab tu gshibs te brkyangs/ de nas rkang pa gnyis btegs te dpral ba sa la reg tsam zhig bya/ yang dpral ba btegs te rkang pa sa la reg tsam zhig bya/ de 'dra ba lan gsum bya'o/ /rjes 'dra/ sum cu pa ni/ rdo rje skyil krung sgyid pa gnyis kyi bar/ /lag pa btsangs te ma shong pus mor 'khyud/ /mgo bo bkug pa'i rna ba lag pas bzung / /kum pa zhes bya bum pa'i 'khrul 'khor yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying gar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas sgyid khung gnyis kyi nang na mar khu tshur gnyis brdzangs te/ mgo bo mar bkug pa'i rna ba gnyis lag pa gnyis kyi mtheb mdzub bzung nas sdod pa'o/ /sgyid khung na mar lag pa ma shong na lag pa gnyis pus mo gnyis kyi phyi nas 'khyud de rna ba gnyis 'dzin no/

/rjes 'dra/ so gcig pa ni/ 'khrul 'khor thams cad de dang 'dra ba las/ 'on kyang lag gnyis ltag pa'i steng du bsnol/ /kur ma zhes bya chu srin 'khrul 'khor te/ /zhes pa ltar/ lus kyi bca' thabs rlung 'dzin pa sogs snga ma bzhin la/ lag pa gnyis ltag pa bsnol nas sdod pa'o/ /rjes 'dra/ so gnyis pa ni/ seng ge rnam rol dag dang sum cu gnyis/ /de ltar de dag kun la kha sbyar te/ /dmigs kyis bstan pa dag ni ma gtogs so/ /mjug tu bstan pa'i 'khrul 'khor drug po ni/ /nad rnams thams cad sel ba'i man ngag yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying gar bsnol bas rlung 'bud cing bzung / de nas lag pa gnyis kyi mdzub mos mig bsdams/ gung mo gnyis kyis sna bug gnyis bsdams/ mthe chung dang srin lag gnyis kyis mchu bsdams/ mthe bong gnyis kyis rna ba gnyis nang du bltabs nas bsdams/ gru mo gnyis drang por bsrangs/ de'i ngang nas stod g.yas su bskor ba gsum/ g.yon du bskor ba gsum/ de nas rlung phyir drag tu gtong ba dang / kha mig rnams bgrad pa dang / ngag gis has sgra drag tu brjod/ lag pa gnyis bya gshog ltar brkyangs/ mgo dang ro stod drag tu dkrug pa dus gcig tu bya'o/ /de ltar na yan lag lnga sbyong 'khrul 'khor lnga ru bgrangs pas sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ /'khrul 'khor thams cad bsgom par 'dod par gyur na/ rim dang rim bzhin dkrug pa dgu bcu drug /gcig dang gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi yi bar/ /ji ltar nus pa sbyangs na sangs rgyas 'grub/ /ces pa ltar/ thog mar dza lan dha ra nas seng ge rnam rol gyi bar dkyus su thengs gcig yang seng ge rnam rol nas dza lan dha ra'i bar yar zlog ste thengs cig yang dkrugs nas sum cu rtsa gnyis rdzogs par bya ste de ltar dgu bcu rtsa drug bya'o/ /yang na na ba li gnyis gcig tu bya/ /rlung gi sbyor ba rnam bdun bsnan pa yis/ /rnal 'byor phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis te/

/thun mong dag tu 'di tsam gsungs pa yin/ /de dag re re dag gi phan yon ni/ /srog rtsol 'chi bslu skra dkar gnyer ma sel/ /srog nas btang bas tshe ring bdud rtsi 'phel/ /gnyis ka nas btang mgo nad mig nad sel/ /kha nas sgra bcas sbrul gdug tshad nad sel/ /srog nas btang bas ma zhu tshad nad sel/ /kha nas sgra med bad kan ma zhu sel/ /kha sbyar gyis ni nad kun sel bar 'gyur/ /de ltar sbyangs pas gegs med ting nge 'dzin/ /myur du skye zhes bla ma'i gsung las thos/ /dza lan dha ra'i zhal shes 'khrul 'khor ni/ /lag gnyis bsnol bas rkang pa'i mkhrig ma bzung / /bsnol mtshams mgo bo bzhag la tshangs rar dgug /tsau rang ga yi zhal shes 'khrul 'khor ni/ /skyil krung rdo rje bsdams pa'i snying gar btsir/ /gru mo rgyab tu ma zhum mdun rgyab kyi/ /dkyil du gru mo sleb pas g.yas g.yon gcu/ /dza tra'i zhal shes 'khrul 'khor 'di nyid ni/ /skyil krung lag gnyis bsnol bas gru mo bzung / /mkha' la btegs te g.yas g.yon steng 'og bskor/ /de nyid g.yas su dgang ste g.yon du dkrug /g.yon pa'ang de bzhin grangs mnyam shes par bya/ /de nyid spyi bor btegs te pho ba brdungs/ /skyil krung lag gnyis bsnol bas dpung pa bzung / /lheng snar gre mo steng 'og res mos brdeg /rkang nad sel ba'i zhal shes 'khrul 'khor ni/ /rlung bzung langs la lus po drang por bsrangs/ /khu tshur gnyis kyis os ko btegs byas nas/ /pus mo mdun du ma gug rkang gnyis gshibs/ /rgyab 'gros mdun 'gros gnyis ka 'phag cing bya/ /rkang pa'i nad la mchog tu phan pa yin/ /zhal shes 'khrul 'khor ma lus bstan zin to/ /sa phal ta ྀatshaḥ zhes pa 'di ni/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i zab lam gyi snying po/ rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor gyi lam la brten nas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par byed pa'i thabs 'di nyid ni/

sngon byon bla ma gong mas mdzad pa'i yig cha dang lus dpe/ grub chen bud+dha shrīs mdzad pa'i 'phrin las so gnyis kyi sdom tshig dang gzhung / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyis byas 'gyur grub chen kun dga' ba la phyag len gsung bgros dang bcas pa gnang ba zin bris su mdzad pa'i yig cha/ rje btsun legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyi rdo rje 'chang kun dga' dbang phyug gis gsung ngag rin po che gsung ba'i skabs su zin bris su mdzad pa'i yan lag lnga sbyong gi yi ge gzhan yang lus sbyong nyi shu pa'i sdom tshig lag len bya tshul dang bcas pa rnams kyi don gyi snying po bslangs shing / khyad par rang nyid byas 'gyur rdo rje'i ri khrod du rim gnyis kyi lam la 'bad rtsol lhur bya ba'i skabs/ bla ma dang chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ de dag gi thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs la brten nas/ byang phyogs rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du nye bar gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa bgres po zhig sgo skyel gyi tshul du sgrub gnas khyad par can nyid mjal ba dang / gnas 'brel zhag kha yar zhig mdzad pa'i skabs/ sa skya pa'i yab chos rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor gyi phyag len rnam par dag pa 'di rnams zhib rgyas su bstsal cing / rang gis kyang blo la 'jags par byas shing / khyad par dpal sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du/ chos kyi rje e wam̐ pa chen po shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis gnyis kyis lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i zab khrid rgyas par gnang ba'i skabs su/ gsung ngag rin po che dang sku'i rnam 'gyur gyis brda ston mdzad pa rnams kyang blo la nges par byas shing / de rnams kyi tshig don phyag len dang bcas pa phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i legs bshad 'di ni/ chos de nyid la don du gnyer ba'i btsun pa lo'i rigs su skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa puṇ+ya dh+wa dzas rang nyid kyi dran pa so phyir dang gzhan la'ang phan pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas rgya gar bas su bhā nuḥzhes pa nyi ma'i lo/

rgya nag pas chu mo lug gi lo'i skar ma chu stod kyi nya ba'i zla ba'i tshes bzhi/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus bzang khyad par can/ res gza' nyi ma dang / rgyu skar rta chung gi me nang 'phrad pa'i gza' skar shis pa'i nyin/ dpal ldan sa skya yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas kyi chos grwa chen po'i dga' ldan bla brang du legs par sbyar ba 'dis bdag gzhan gyi lus kyi rtsa mdud rnams rim pas grol nas sa dang lam thams cad bgrod de/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la myur du thob par gyur cig 'dir smras pa/ bir+wa'i gzhung bzang rdo rje tshig rkang dang / /sa skya'i bla chen rnams kyis legs bkral ba'i/ /snyan brgyud gsung rab mchog las byung ba yi/ /rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor lam 'di e ma mtshar/ /'on kyang zab don snying po'i lam bzang 'di/ /snyigs ma'i dus der mkho ba min zhes pa/ /blun po man ngag bral ba 'ga' smras mod/ /blo ldan snying po'i gdams ngag 'dir 'bad na/ /thun mong dag tu lus bde ngal dub med/ /'gro tshe rta 'dra khur tshe glang chen ltar/ /stobs dang ldan zhing sa lam bgrod nus pa'i/ /myur lam 'di la brtson par byed pa rigs/ /zhes kyang smras so/ /zhib tu rlung 'dzin tshul phyag len phra mo dang bcas pa rnams bla ma'i gsung las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar gsung ngag rin po che 'chad cing nyams su len pa la med thabs med pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi lag len bklags chog ma 'di ni/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab dang phyag len bzhin gdan sa chen po'i brgya tsho dpon gyi bla ma chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis lag len zin bris kyi tshul du bkod 'dug pa la/ slar sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis yig cha 'di la zhib tu bltas nas sngar rang gis byas pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi yig cha de cung zad mang ches pas de nyid kyi snying po bsdus pa lta bu zhig 'dug pas rang nyid kyang blo 'gro bar byung ba nas/

bstan bcos de la zhus dag zhib tu byas nas rang gi brtsams chos glegs bam rnams kyi grwa la 'jug pa'i phyir dbur bla ma yi dam la rgya skad kyi mchod brjod/ mjug tu yang tshigs bcad bsnan te/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mgyogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpyod ldan mi dbang rnam rgyal rdo rjes phyag sor gyi 'du byed las bskrun pa'o/ /'di bgyis dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /phyi ma bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi /dag pa'i zhing du thogs med legs bskyal nas/ /gzhan stobs mthu des bdag gi re ba bzhin/ /yid bzhin 'grub nas rang don mthar phyin te/ /gang 'dul sprul pas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa dkar 'jam byed pa'i mthu ldan shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor la brten nas rnal 'byor pa rnams zab lam byang chub sgrub pa'i rim pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
